profile.headline: Software Engineer at Kulicke and Soffa
profile.summary: Senior software engineer with a focus on reliable, real-time software.   I enjoy optimizing software to meet critical deadlines, using test-driven development to prevent defects, and reducing development cost with reusable architectures and components,

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop real-time, embedded C++ software to control a semiconductor packaging machines.  Specific projects included interfacing to third-party sensors, data acquisition devices and communication buses,  developing calibrations and health checks including data analysis and visualization, developing re-usable frameworks, and developing adapters for motor control hardware.   Optimize software to meet hard deadlines.   Projects are executed in an Agile environment with a focus on test-driven development.  Primary language is C++, with light use of Java, MATLAB, Python, and JavaScript/HighCharts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Small team leader, software designer and software/hardware integrator for secure military communication and storage devices.  Skills: Model-driven development (Rhapsody toolset), Object-Oriented Design, C++, real-time embedded software, GHS INTEGRITY.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, implemented and performed field-testing for data and voice RF network device for military use (tactical internet).  Skills: UML (Rhapsody and Rational Rose), Object-Oriented Design, C++, real-time embedded linux, POSIX, VxWorks, JTRS architecture.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed SAP modules to provide business reports and feeds to data warehouses and data marts.  Skills: SAP, ABAP/4, SQL, Oracle, COGNOS Imptomptu, COGNOS Powercube.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Developed embedded software for parking systems.  Provided field support for deployed systems.   Skills: Borland Delphi, Object-Oriented Design, Win32 application development, Intel 8085 Assembly language.
